final: WITH p AS (SELECT oi.product_id, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(*) AS n_items, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items) AS share FROM Order_Items oi GROUP BY oi.product_id), t AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(p.avg_qty) AS a, AVG(p.n_items) AS n, AVG(p.share) AS s FROM p JOIN Products pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = pr.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_of_avg_quantity, AVG(n) AS avg_of_order_item_count, AVG(s) AS avg_of_share FROM t
